topicName: What is JPQL (Java Persistence Query Language)? How does it differ from SQL?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is JPQL (Java Persistence Query Language)? How does it differ from SQL?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"JPQL is an object-oriented query language used to make queries against entities stored in a relational database. Unlike SQL, which operates on tables and columns, JPQL operates on Java objects and their properties. This provides a level of abstraction, making queries more portable across different database systems."}]
